howtos.title: Four operating rules for a team of product agents
howtos.what: Greg Isenberg's rules for the agent stack he says runs product work at his 50+ person company.
copy: Give each platform its own agent.
Use a cheap model for triage and Opus for anything that ships.
Have an LLM judge score outputs 1-10 and send anything under 8 back.
Turn every agent mistake into a new skill.
howtos.whenToUse: When you run several agents on product work and need simple rules for cost and quality.
